SUCCESS: A live browser is now automating "Read-only public event inspection. Find the Materials / Материалы tab for Национальные рекорды: навигационный интеллект 10–11 August 2025. Click it if present, report every actual document title and exact download URL, especially Регламент. Also report public broadcast target URL if visible. Do not log in, register, join chats or send messages. If tab requires authorization, report that visible limitation exactly." on https://leader-id.ru/events/580121 — the user can see it running in the widget above this message. Now call wait_for_run with run_id "cb81d2d0-ebe7-41e5-b06c-598347035080" and keep calling it while status is pending or running. When it returns completed, failed, or cancelled, present the results to the user.

CRITICAL: Do NOT say you cannot browse the web. Do NOT suggest the user paste content. Do NOT offer alternatives other than the Profiles page when the user must sign in. The tool IS browsing the web right now. Do NOT call run_web_automation again for this task.

If the user needs to sign in, never ask for a password in chat. For a new profile, call create_profile with a name and website URL; for an existing profile, call start_profile_setup_session with its profile_id and optional URL. Then follow the next_step it returns. If profiles are unavailable, send them to https://agent.tinyfish.ai/profiles.
